description: This file defines the CalVideoSettingsRepository class with static methods for managing video settings in a database using Prisma ORM.

classes.name: CalVideoSettingsRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing static methods to delete, create, and update video settings related to events.

methods.name: deleteCalVideoSettings
methods.description: Deletes video settings for a given event type ID.

methods.name: createCalVideoSettings
methods.description: Creates new video settings for a specified event type ID with provided configuration.

methods.name: createOrUpdateCalVideoSettings
methods.description: Upserts (creates or updates) video settings for a given event type ID with provided configuration.
